dynamicTools.description: Work with the person's other threads. A thread you assign is an ordinary thread the person can open, talk to and stop; its agent works on your brief, and when a turn you gave it (by the brief or a message) ends, its last reply comes back to you as a message. A message from another thread is a user message that begins with <thread-message from="<thread id>" title="<title>"/>, with report="completed", "stopped" or "failed" when it reports how a turn you gave ended; answer one with `message`. A message to a thread that is running waits for its turn to end.
dynamicTools.name: chirality

tools.description: Start a new thread with a title and a brief (its first message), in this thread's project or another, and return its id. Model, reasoning effort and access are this thread's unless named; access can only be the same or lower (the new thread's agent asks the person for more).

brief.description: The work, as the new thread's first message.

effort.description: A reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh.

project.description: A project's name or path, from `threads`; this thread's project when left out.

workflow.description: A workflow's name or id, for the new thread to follow.

tools.name: assign

tools.description: Send text to another thread. It starts a turn there, or waits until the turn running there ends.
tools.name: message

tools.description: The threads you can address, in every project: each with its title, project, whether it is running, idle or waiting on the person, and whether you assigned it or it assigned you.
tools.name: threads

tools.description: End an assignment you made: no more reports come from that thread.
tools.name: close
